description: Defines the NameConstraints class for parsing and testing certificate name constraints as per RFC 5280, including methods for checking permitted DNS names, directory names, and IP addresses.

classes.name: net::NameConstraints
classes.description: Handles parsing and validation of certificate name constraints, including permitted subtrees, excluded subtrees, and name type constraints.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a NameConstraints object by parsing DER-encoded extension data.

methods.name: IsPermittedCert
methods.description: Checks if a certificate complies with the name constraints.

methods.name: IsPermittedDNSName
methods.description: Checks if a DNS name is permitted under the constraints.

methods.name: IsPermittedDirectoryName
methods.description: Checks if a directory name is permitted.

methods.name: IsPermittedIP
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is permitted.
